purpose: Matched unprofiled seam overhead with untouched user application ambient load and same-binary existing-transition-GC controls; no product-policy change

fixture.preset: Original, explicit High shadows, resolution100%, nearest/no mip/anisotropy1/replacements disabled

ambientLimits: User-owned Project Prime app is left running; results are conditional on observed ambient load, not strict quiet-host performance proof. No malloc stack logging.

cleanup.scope: GC diagnostic cleanup: only weak scene reference and numeric handles cross EndScene; no extra GC or finalizer drain. Ordinary ownership-field inspection is a separate check.

limits: Medians of per-run percentiles are not pooled percentiles. User-owned game remains running; agent-idle conditional ambient data does not establish a global-quiet optimization result or GPU/native-allocation causality. Stage scopes exclude construction/AddRoom; latest GC snapshot can predate a skipped call. Weak last foreground owner is intentional and bounded; no production policy changes.
